# Which duration, curve, loop and layer values exist?

Read this when markup of yours needs a time, a curve, a stacking order or the period of an animation that repeats.

**`--dur-*`** is how long a transition runs, and **`--ease-*`** is the curve it follows. **`--loop-*`** is the period of an animation that repeats. **`--z-*`** is the stacking order of the layers Arena draws, so a layer of yours sits above or below them by reading the same scale.

<!-- @shared motion GENERATED by bun run generate:npm-pages. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

A row marked `none` has no utility named for its token, so read it with `var()`. Where the sheet resets a Tailwind default scale (ease), a utility of that default, such as `ease-in`, emits nothing and reports nothing.

| --- | --- | --- |

| `--dur-mid` | `220ms` | none |
| `--dur-slow` | `420ms` | none |
| `--loop-spin` | `700ms` | none |
| `--loop-sweep` | `1150ms` | none |
| `--loop-shimmer` | `1400ms` | none |
| `--loop-brand` | `8000ms` | none |
| `--loop-reduced` | `2400ms` | none |
| `--loop-brand-reduced` | `24000ms` | none |
| `--ease-out` | `cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1)` | `ease-out` |
| `--ease-in-out` | `cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)` | `ease-in-out` |
| `--ease-emphatic` | `cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.1,1)` | `ease-emphatic` |
| `--z-nav` | `800` | `z-nav` |
| `--z-skip` | `820` | `z-skip` |
